symptom: Across several controller turns, UAOS accepted the latest user framing or a newly discovered implementation defect as the active root problem and moved toward repair before the existing deliberation, architecture challenge and evolution mechanisms had established the correct problem layer. The same failure repeated even after policy text already required micro->macro->micro reasoning.
user_impact: The user had to repeatedly force UAOS to challenge architecture/upstream assumptions, enter cognition/evolution handling, and avoid local patching. This creates unnecessary repairs, governance bloat and low confidence that the controller can discover problems independently.
micro_diagnosis: src/uaos/kernel/problem_closure.py originally treated repair_path_available + repair_authorized as sufficient to produce REPAIR_NOW; it had no root-scope or evolution-admission evidence fields.
src/uaos/kernel/deliberation.py originally enforced evidence dimensions but did not emit an evidence-tested problem-layer/root-hypothesis receipt consumed by action admission.
Evolution lifecycle existed separately, so a repair could be selected without a mechanically prior learning/evolution disposition.
Existing policy prose already required macro/topology and governing-assumption challenge, proving the defect was ordering/integration rather than simply missing guidance text.
macro_goal_and_topology_alignment: UAOS remains one parent control plane; this repair does not introduce a second architecture advisor, second controller, global child journal or parallel scheduler.
The owning abstraction is the common Problem -> Cognition -> Evolution -> Action control chain shared by UAOS and registered domains.
Authority, domain business ownership, runtime persistence and child internal evidence formats remain unchanged.

competing_hypotheses.evidence: Specific scheduler/upcall defects exist, but the controller repeatedly entered implementation repair before validating whether those were root causes. Fixing them alone would not prevent recurrence in another subsystem.

UAOS already had architecture-experience and deliberation policies requiring macro/topology challenge and scenario evaluation; the recurring failure persisted, so another guidance-only method would be insufficient.

Deliberation, problem closure and evolution were separate executable mechanisms; repair closure could be reached without a root-scope receipt or evolution disposition. This reproduced the observed premature-action behavior.

Observed repeat failures concentrate in the cognition/action boundary. No current evidence shows authority ownership, domain isolation, runtime persistence or the whole topology must be replaced. A bounded control-chain redesign is lower-risk and directly testable.

post_promotion_findings.finding: ProblemClosureSignals still allowed the caller to set problem_record_required=false even when the root-scope risk pattern itself should make durable causal evidence mandatory.
post_promotion_findings.repair: Root-scope admission now derives durable_problem_record_required from material/systemic/risk signals; closure may accept a caller request for stronger evidence but cannot accept a downgrade.

post_promotion_findings.finding: evolution_disposition accepted any non-empty string, so a caller could syntactically claim learning/evolution without a governed disposition.
post_promotion_findings.repair: Problem closure now requires a typed EvolutionDisposition; arbitrary strings fail admission.

post_promotion_findings.finding: This evolution record remained CANDIDATE_IMPLEMENTED_AWAITING_CI after PR #33 had merged and candidate/live/production CI had passed.
post_promotion_findings.repair: Evolution-state freshness is now included in the same closure evidence; this record carries actual baseline and hardening promotion evidence.

verified_properties: A repairable symptom cannot reach REPAIR_NOW without a root-scope receipt.
User framing or an external method cannot be promoted directly to root cause without falsification evidence.
Repeated/cross-subsystem/material/architecture-risk problems require cross-layer competing hypotheses and explicit upstream/architecture reassessment.
Durable causal-evidence requirement is derived by root-scope admission and cannot be downgraded by the closure caller.
Arbitrary strings cannot impersonate an evolution/learning disposition.
An admitted authorized repair still cannot end at recommendation-only.
Small single local problems remain eligible for lightweight single-layer root-scope handling and do not automatically require a durable record.
